post.text:
🚨 JUST IN: The US House has PASSED a resolution supporting full funding for the Department of Homeland Security, 225-187

OVER 95% PERCENT of Democrats who voted went against it.

100% of voting Republicans supported it.

Imagine that.

Democrats are traitors! https://t.co/wAoauWtI9L
post.author_description: Chief Content Officer @RightLineNews @FLVoiceNews | Marylander-turned-Floridian | Politics & breaking news alerts | “Men must vote” - Charlie Kirk

description.description: A series of frames showing the results of a vote in the U.S. House of Representatives. Frame 1 displays atogether widely-shot view of the House Chamber with a vote tally overlay for H. RES. 1128. Frame 2 shows a cross-fade transition between the chamber view and a close-up of the Speaker pro tempore. Frames 3 and 4 feature Representative Daniel Meuser presiding as Speaker pro tempore, with his name and title appearing in a graphic in the final frame.
